# Hard Cases

## Deeply nested lists

- level 1
  - level 2
    - level 3
      - level 4
        - level 5

## Blockquote of blockquote

> outer quote
>
> > inner quote with **strong** and `code`
> >
> > - item a
> > - item b

## Table with mixed inline

| Feature | Support | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *italic* | yes | renders |
| **bold** | yes | renders |
| `code` | yes | renders |
| [link](https://e.com) | yes | rendered |
| ~~strike~~ | yes | gfm |

## Multiple paragraphs in a list item

1. First item, first paragraph.

   First item, second paragraph.

2. Second item.

   Second item has a code block:

   ```
   block inside item
   ```
